A clean 2D orthographic three-view reference sheet of ONE single object: a pet cat bed, drawn on a plain warm white background. The sheet is divided into three evenly spaced panels arranged left to right, all in the same flat vector illustration style with gentle soft shading and no perspective distortion.

PANEL 1 - FRONT ELEVATION: the cat bed seen perfectly straight on from the front, straight-on horizontal eye level. It is a soft tan basket-shaped pet bed: a low rounded rectangular tub with softly rounded corners, warm sand-tan woven-looking walls, a slightly taller bolster rim at the back and lower rims at the front and both sides, and a plump soft misty blue cushion filling the inside of the tub, the cushion surface slightly rumpled.

PANEL 2 - TOP VIEW: the same cat bed seen perfectly straight down from above, a plain plan view. You see the rounded rectangular tan outer rim as a ring, the misty blue cushion nested inside it, and the opening of the tub.

PANEL 3 - SIDE ELEVATION: the same cat bed seen perfectly straight on from its right-hand side, straight-on horizontal eye level. You see the tan tub profile, the higher back bolster on the left of this panel, the lower front rim on the right, and the misty blue cushion edge sitting inside the rim.

DIMENSION ANNOTATIONS: thin dark-gray dimension lines with small arrowheads and small neat sans-serif labels in meters, placed beside each view. For the front elevation label the overall width as 1.20 m and the overall height as 0.60 m, and add a second small label with a leader line pointing at the top surface of the blue cushion reading 0.54 m. For the top view label the width as 1.20 m and the depth as 1.00 m. For the side elevation label the depth as 1.00 m. Keep the annotation text small, sparse and legible, only these measurement labels and nothing else written.

STYLE: clean flat vector shapes with soft simple shading, warm sand tan for the bed shell, soft misty blue for the cushion, subtle soft contact shadow beneath the object, absolutely no perspective, no isometric angle, perfectly straight orthographic lines, plain warm off-white background, no extra text, no title, no captions, no extra labels, no watermark

A clean 2D orthographic three-view reference sheet of ONE single object: a small two-seat sofa, drawn on a plain warm white background. The sheet is divided into three evenly spaced panels arranged left to right, all in the same flat vector illustration style with gentle soft shading and no perspective distortion.

PANEL 1 - FRONT ELEVATION: the sofa seen perfectly straight on from the front, straight-on horizontal eye level, its long side facing you. It is a plush cream two-seat sofa: a warm cream rounded frame and backrest, two thick soft misty blue seat cushions side by side, softly rounded cream armrests at both ends, short dark brown tapered legs, and a small misty blue square pillow with a white star pattern leaning against the right end of the backrest.

PANEL 2 - TOP VIEW: the same sofa seen perfectly straight down from above, a plain plan view. You see the long rectangular cream outer shape with the rounded armrest ends, the backrest band along the far edge, and the two misty blue seat cushions in the middle.

PANEL 3 - SIDE ELEVATION: the same sofa seen perfectly straight on from its right-hand end, straight-on horizontal eye level, so you see the narrow end of the sofa with the cream armrest, the edge of the blue cushion and the cream backrest behind it.

DIMENSION ANNOTATIONS: thin dark-gray dimension lines with small arrowheads and small neat sans-serif labels in meters, placed beside each view. For the front elevation label the overall length as 2.00 m and the overall height as 1.15 m, and add a second small label with a leader line pointing at the top surface of the seat cushions reading 0.99 m. For the top view label the length as 2.00 m and the depth as 0.95 m. For the side elevation label the depth as 0.95 m. Keep the annotation text small, sparse and legible, only these measurement labels and nothing else written.

STYLE: clean flat vector shapes with soft simple shading, warm cream for the sofa frame and backrest, soft misty blue for the seat cushions, dark warm brown for the legs, subtle soft contact shadow beneath the object, absolutely no perspective, no isometric angle, perfectly straight orthographic lines, plain warm off-white background, no extra text, no title, no captions, no extra labels, no watermark
